project_type: Python data-pipeline (Flask backend, Angular frontend) — AI demand forecasting and dynamic pricing system for retail
build_system: data-pipeline uses its own venv at data-pipeline/venv. Backend uses backend/venv (or same venv). No monorepo build tool — each component has its own requirements.txt.
test_framework: pytest for data-pipeline (run from data-pipeline/ with venv activated: python -m pytest tests/), pytest for backend (run from backend/ with venv activated: python -m pytest tests/), Jasmine/Karma for Angular (npx ng test from frontend/)
build_command: N/A — no compile step for Python. For Angular: npx ng build from frontend/.
test_command: Backend tests: cd /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v. Data-pipeline tests: cd /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/data-pipeline && python -m pytest tests/ -v. Evaluation scripts: cd /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/evaluation && python run_evaluation.py
verification_instructions: 1. Run data-pipeline tests: cd data-pipeline && python -m pytest tests/ -v (requires DB). 2. Run backend tests: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v (requires DB and model artifacts). 3. Run evaluation scripts: cd evaluation && python run_evaluation.py (requires DB and pipeline artifacts). 4. Check all results/ outputs exist: ls evaluation/results/.
snapshot_or_generated_files: evaluation/results/ contains generated JSON/CSV/PNG files (not checked in — add to .gitignore). Model artifacts at data-pipeline/models/artifacts/production_model.joblib and metadata.json are checked in. Raw and cleaned CSVs are git-ignored.
environment_constraints: DB credentials must be in data-pipeline/.env (DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_NAME=revenue_management, DB_GT_NAME=revenue_management_gt). data-pipeline/venv must exist. Never restart the backend — it is not required for evaluation scripts (only for system_performance API timing). LLM API key (LLM_API_KEY) optional — llm_layer_eval.py has --with-llm flag that is OFF by default.
contribution_requirements: MEASURE ONLY — never change algorithms, parameters, SQL, schema, models, or application behavior. Database access from evaluation scripts is read-only (SELECT only). Ground-truth columns (true_elasticity, true_segment) may be read ONLY inside evaluation scripts from gt_* tables via get_gt_engine(). Evaluation code must live outside application packages (backend/, data-pipeline/ except tests/). No application code may import evaluation code.
key_patterns: 1. All data-pipeline modules use sys.path.insert(0, PIPELINE_ROOT) at top for imports. 2. DB connection: from etl.db_connection import get_engine (app DB), get_gt_engine (ground truth DB revenue_management_gt). Both use lru_cache. 3. Model artifact: data-pipeline/models/artifacts/production_model.joblib (joblib), metadata.json (JSON). 4. Feature CSV: data-pipeline/data/features/forecast_features.csv. 5. time_split() in models/data_split.py is the canonical way to reproduce the train/test split. 6. evaluate.py::compute_metrics() uses EPSILON=1e-8 in MAPE denominator. 7. Clustering uses RANDOM_STATE=42, PRODUCTION_K=4. 8. Ground truth in MySQL revenue_management_gt database: tables gt_product_elasticity (product_id, true_elasticity) and gt_customer_segment (customer_id, true_segment, purchase_rate, basket_mean, basket_std).
directory_structure: repo-root/: backend/ (Flask app), data-pipeline/ (all pipeline stages; has own venv), frontend/ (Angular), scripts/ (run_pipeline.py, verify_system.py), docs/, database/, demo/. data-pipeline/: data_generation/, etl/, features/, models/, segmentation/, pricing/, explanations/, tests/. Model artifacts at data-pipeline/models/artifacts/. Feature CSV at data-pipeline/data/features/. Ground-truth CSVs at data-pipeline/data/raw/ (git-ignored). Evaluation scripts go in repo-root/evaluation/ (NEW). Test results go in repo-root/evaluation/results/ (NEW).
